title: Research on the impact mechanism of monetary policy shocks and the synergy of human capital structure on corporate investment
title_zh: 货币政策冲击与人力资本结构协同对企业投资的影响机制研究
title_primary: 货币政策冲击与人力资本结构协同对企业投资的影响机制研究
title_secondary: Research on the impact mechanism of monetary policy shocks and the synergy of human capital structure on corporate investment
authors: Bin Hao, Zehao Wang, Lei Yin
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study investigates how monetary policy uncertainty shapes corporate investment efficiency based on an unbalanced panel of 5,090 Chinese A-share listed firms over the period 2011–2024. The findings indicate that heightened monetary policy uncertainty leads to a significant deterioration in investment efficiency. This relationship remains stable after adopting alternative measures, introducing lagged terms, removing observations from the COVID-19 period, and applying instrumental-variable estimation. Mechanism analysis shows that tighter financing constraints and lower R&D expenditure constitute two important channels underlying this effect. The negative influence is particularly evident among capital-intensive and technology-intensive firms, state-owned enterprises, and firms characterized by CEO duality. Moreover, an upgraded human capital structure enhances firms’ capacity to absorb policy-related shocks and weakens the adverse effect of monetary policy uncertainty. These findings advance the understanding of firm-level responses to macroeconomic policy uncertainty and offer practical insights into policy communication, innovation financing, human capital allocation, and corporate investment management.
abstract_zh: 本研究基于2011–2024年间5090家中国A股上市公司的非平衡面板数据，考察货币政策不确定性如何影响企业投资效率。研究发现，货币政策不确定性上升会显著降低企业投资效率。在采用替代性指标、引入滞后项、剔除新冠疫情时期观测值以及运用工具变量估计后，该结论依然稳健。机制分析表明，融资约束趋紧与研发支出下降是这一效应的两个重要传导渠道。这种负面影响在资本密集型和技术密集型企业、国有企业以及董事长兼任总经理的企业中尤为显著。此外，人力资本结构升级能够增强企业吸收政策冲击的能力，从而削弱货币政策不确定性的不利影响。这些发现深化了对企业应对宏观经济政策不确定性的理解，并为政策沟通、创新融资、人力资本配置及企业投资管理提供了实践启示。关键词：货币政策不确定性；投资效率；融资约束；研发投资；人力资本结构 JEL分类号：M21 G38 M10 J24

title: Global Financial Transparency and Offshore Wealth Accumulation
title_zh: 全球金融透明度与离岸财富积累
title_primary: 全球金融透明度与离岸财富积累
title_secondary: Global Financial Transparency and Offshore Wealth Accumulation
authors: Annette Alstadsæter, Niels Johannesen, Ségal Le Guern Herry, Gabriel Zucman
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper uses administrative data to analyze wealth flows from Norway to offshore tax havens before and after a major improvement of global financial transparency: automatic exchange of bank account information between tax authorities. We present three results suggesting that the policy is a significant deterrent of offshore tax evasion: First, taxpayers who become wealthy are much less likely to shift wealth to offshore banks. Second, when wealth does flow to offshore banks, it is much less likely to reduce domestic tax payments. Third, there is no increase in the use of complex ownership structures for offshore wealth flows.
abstract_zh: 本文利用行政数据分析全球金融透明度重大提升——即税务机关之间自动交换银行账户信息——前后，挪威流向离岸避税天堂的财富变化。我们提出三项结果，表明该政策对离岸逃税具有显著威慑作用：第一，新晋富裕纳税人将财富转移至离岸银行的概率大幅降低；第二，即便财富流向离岸银行，其减少国内纳税的可能性也显著下降；第三，离岸财富流动中复杂所有权结构的使用并未增加。

title: Designing Donor Registries: Behavioral Drivers of Enrollment and Giving
title_zh: 设计捐赠者登记系统：注册与捐赠行为的驱动因素
title_primary: 设计捐赠者登记系统：注册与捐赠行为的驱动因素
title_secondary: Designing Donor Registries: Behavioral Drivers of Enrollment and Giving
authors: Lorko, Matej, Servátka, Maroš, Slonim, Robert
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Many charitable organizations invite potential donors to first join a registry before soliciting donations from those who have joined. Behavioral theories suggest that the choice architecture of registry enrollment can influence not just participation but also future giving. Some approaches may be relatively more likely to increase the likelihood of joining but reduce the subsequent propensity to donate and the amount donated, while other methods might have the opposite effect. We experimentally test four behavioral theories – overhead aversion, status quo bias, reciprocity, and moral consistency – in a two-stage donor engagement model. We find that (1) disclosing registry-related overhead costs decreases donations, (2) changing the default enrollment method (op-in vs. opt-out) does not affect enrollment nor donations, (3) targeting reciprocity by offering a small gift conditional on joining the registry boosts enrollment but not donations, and (4) targeting moral consistency by requesting an upfront contribution does not decrease the likelihood of joining the registry and can improve charity returns. Our findings emphasize how subtle differences in the design of early-stage donor approaches can influence longer-term fundraising outcomes.
abstract_zh: 许多慈善组织会先邀请潜在捐赠者加入登记册，随后再向已加入者募捐。行为理论表明，登记注册的选择架构不仅会影响参与行为，还会影响未来的捐赠意愿。某些方法可能更易提高加入登记册的可能性，但会降低后续捐赠倾向及金额；而另一些方法则可能产生相反效果。我们通过两阶段捐赠者参与模型，对四种行为理论——管理费用厌恶、现状偏差、互惠原则与道德一致性——进行了实验检验。研究发现：（1）披露与登记册相关的管理费用会减少捐赠；（2）改变默认注册方式（选择加入与选择退出）对注册率及捐赠均无影响；（3）通过提供注册后附赠小礼品来触发互惠机制，虽能提升注册率，但未增加捐赠额；（4）通过要求预先捐款来触发道德一致性，既未降低注册可能性，还能提升慈善收益。我们的研究结果强调，早期捐赠者接触方式设计中的细微差异，可能对长期筹款成效产生深远影响。

title: Public Health, Human Capital, and Economic Growth: The Lasting Effects of Disease Control in China
title_zh: 公共卫生、人力资本与经济增长：中国疾病控制的持久影响
title_primary: 公共卫生、人力资本与经济增长：中国疾病控制的持久影响
title_secondary: Public Health, Human Capital, and Economic Growth: The Lasting Effects of Disease Control in China
authors: Fan He, Wei Huang, Yinghao Pan, Jiao Wang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper investigates the long-term impacts of China’s nationwide public health campaigns targeting malaria, measles, and meningitis between the 1960s and 1980s. Exploiting regional variation in precampaign disease prevalence across birth cohorts, we show that these interventions generated sizable improvements in education, cognition, health, and income. As an illustrative case, individuals from high-malaria regions who were fully exposed to the eradication campaign attained about 0.5 additional years of schooling and earned over 10% higher income in adulthood, with cognitive and schooling gains explaining a substantial share of the income effects. Extending the same approach to measles and meningitis vaccination campaigns reveals comparably large benefits, with internal rates of return ranging from 21% to 34%. Together, these findings highlight the lasting socioeconomic returns to early-life health interventions and underscore the role of public health as a foundation for human capital accumulation and long-run economic growth.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了20世纪60至80年代中国针对疟疾、麻疹和脑膜炎开展的全国性公共卫生运动的长期影响。利用不同出生队列在运动前疾病流行率的地区差异，我们证明这些干预措施显著改善了教育、认知、健康和收入水平。以疟疾为例，来自高疟疾地区且完全暴露于根除运动的个体，其受教育年限平均增加约0.5年，成年后收入提高超过10%，其中认知能力和教育水平的提升解释了收入效应的很大一部分。将相同方法应用于麻疹和脑膜炎疫苗接种运动后，同样发现了可观的收益，内部收益率介于21%至34%之间。这些发现共同凸显了早期健康干预的持久社会经济回报，并强调了公共卫生作为人力资本积累和长期经济增长基础的关键作用。

title: To innovate or not to innovate? CEO’s health risk matters
title_zh: 创新还是不创新？CEO的健康风险至关重要
title_primary: 创新还是不创新？CEO的健康风险至关重要
title_secondary: To innovate or not to innovate? CEO’s health risk matters
authors: Hao Shen, Rujun Luo, Wei Wang
abstract: The upper echelons theory posits that managerial traits have important impacts on corporate strategies, but health risk, as a critical trait of CEOs, has long been overlooked. Based on data from the Chinese CDC, this paper reveals that when CEOs are confronted with higher health risks, they are likely to reduce investment in corporate innovation; managerial myopia and risk aversion play intermediary roles in the relationship. Furthermore, CEOs’ compensation and educational attainment can effectively mitigate the negative impact of health risk. The inhibitory effect of CEO health risk on corporate innovation is more evident in non-state-owned and non-high-tech firms. By incorporating managers’ health into the framework of upper echelons theory, this study extends and enriches the literature, providing robust empirical evidence that CEO health risk is a consequential driver of corporate strategic decisions.
abstract_zh: 高层梯队理论认为，管理者特质对企业战略具有重要影响，但健康风险作为首席执行官的关键特质长期被忽视。基于中国疾控中心数据，本文揭示当首席执行官面临较高健康风险时，其倾向于减少企业创新投入；管理者短视与风险规避在其中发挥中介作用。此外，首席执行官的薪酬水平与教育程度能有效缓解健康风险的负面影响。首席执行官健康风险对企业创新的抑制作用在非国有企业与非高科技企业中更为显著。通过将管理者健康纳入高层梯队理论框架，本研究拓展并丰富了相关文献，为首席执行官健康风险是企业战略决策的重要驱动因素提供了稳健的经验证据。
